responsibility: This is the main implementation file of the NDS32 GCC backend. It defines the target’s core code-generation logic and target hooks, including register and calling-convention handling, prologue/epilogue generation, address legitimacy, PIC/TLS and section behavior, asm printing, attributes, builtins hookup, option override logic, alignment decisions, and targetm initialization, making it the central orchestrator that binds the port’s helper modules and machine descriptions into a complete GCC target.
same_name_distinction: Within the nds32 same-name set, this is the executable backend implementation file: it contains the target hook functions, helper tables, builtin hookup, asm output logic, and targetm initialization that apply the policies declared in nds32.h, the instruction patterns in nds32.md, and the options generated from nds32.opt.
